answer: We model a Sybil-resistant protocol where each computational inlet requires zero-knowledge verifiable delay alongside a staking collateral C. Under a penalty terrace within the slashing matrix, identity multiplication incurs an exponential penalty scaling to its zenith, ensuring the marginal cost of simulated nodes exceeds their reward. Consequently, the expected utility of an attack becomes strictly negative, establishing a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium where honest participation remains the dominant strategy.
